intent.objective: Make ContextCompiler task-contract discovery ignore everything under agent-system/runtime/
intent.rationale: _find_task_contract globs agent-system/** including agent-system/runtime/worktrees/**, so a leased worktree's copy of a contract can shadow or duplicate the real contract
non_goals: Changing how contracts are validated or hashed
Changing context compilation other than contract discovery
acceptance_behavior: Discovery ignores every file under agent-system/runtime/ (worktrees, attempts, integration copies) and still finds the one real contract
Discovery behaves identically when no agent-system/runtime directory exists
When no contract exists for the task id outside the runtime directory, the existing PlanningError (task contract file was not found) is raised

scope.expected_change_shape: A small change to _find_task_contract in context.py plus one new test module

deterministic_checks: PYTHONPATH=tools/agentctl python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agentctl/tests -t tools/agentctl -p test_context_runtime_exclusion.py
PYTHONPATH=tools/agentctl python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agentctl/tests -t tools/agentctl -p test_context_staleness.py
PYTHONPATH=tools/agentctl python3 -m unittest discover -s tools/agentctl/tests -t tools/agentctl -p test_plan_loading.py
behavioral_requirements: The new tests use a real temporary repository layout with a contract copy under agent-system/runtime/worktrees and prove the real contract is returned
Existing context and plan tests still pass unchanged
definition_of_done: The candidate passes the deterministic checks, receives an independent review with no blocking findings, and is integrated unchanged

replan_conditions: The fix needs a file outside the writable set
